input.reportText: Exposed wires hanging near the water pump on level 2. Floor is wet and two workers walk past it every hour.

classifier.summary: Exposed live wires near a wet area on level 2.
classifier.suggestedAction: Isolate power and keep workers away from the area.

output.summary: Exposed wires near a wet floor create an electrocution risk for passing workers.
output.suggestedAction: Switch off power to the pump circuit and cordon off the wet area now.
output.rationale: Exposed conductors combined with water and regular foot traffic make contact likely, and electric shock can be fatal.

recommendations.title: Isolate power and cordon off the area
recommendations.description: Switch off the supply to the pump circuit, lock it out, and block access to the wet area until it is cleared.

recommendations.title: Repair and insulate the wiring
recommendations.description: A qualified electrician should replace damaged cable, fit proper conduit and insulation, and test the circuit.

recommendations.title: Fix the water leak and add a GFCI
recommendations.description: Find and repair the source of the water, and install ground-fault protection on the pump circuit.

output.uncertaintyNotes: Voltage and exact wire condition were not stated in the report.
